title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：tale　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tale 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the writer ① told the tale that no reader in the study would have measured, and he said the telling was the whole of the month. The ② tale, meaning the story itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a tale, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ tale in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ tale at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tale, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the writer said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tale was the whole of the matter, meaning the wisdom and not the story. The ⑥ tale, meaning the wisdom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; tale, he said, is either something you tell or the only word that means both a story and a wisdom. He said the wisdom is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ tale had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ tale of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of measuring; tale, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tale I remember is the story measured in the manuscript, which closed in 1997 and is still measured as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ tale, my mother said in 1999, is the only story that improves by being measured; every tale, she said, is a wisdom that has agreed to look like a story. She said the wisdom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 故事；传说（指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 故事；传说（指那个故事本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：tell the tale 讲这一个故事
D. n. 故事；传说（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 故事之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的故事之事）
F. n. 故事；传说（指手稿里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 故事、道理（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 道理（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: told the tale that no reader in the study would have measured
The tale, meaning the story itself and not the page
the tale at the far shelf
the tale was the whole of the matter
the tale had become a line in a manuscript
The tale of the whole thing
A tale, my mother said in 1999

answers.why: tell the tale 意为“讲这一个故事”，1990 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯测量的一个故事做了一遍。
tale 意为“故事；传说”，指那个故事本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
tale 意为“故事；传说”，指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
tale 意为“故事；传说”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tale 意为“故事、道理”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个道理就是那件事的全部。
tale 意为“道理”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个故事，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tale 意为“故事；传说”，指手稿里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1995 年这一个成了手稿里的一行。
tale 意为“故事之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的故事之事是一处书斋和三个月份的测量。
tale 意为“故事；传说”，我记得的是手稿里测量过的那一个，1997 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一个。
tale 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，故事是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的故事。
